fixtures.note: These cases run against real CI artifact bundles, which are tens of MB and are not committed. Download the results archive from a pde2e Windows nightly pipeline run, extract it, and point the prompt at the extracted results/podman-desktop directory. The paths below are one maintainer's local copies — substitute your own.

evals.prompt: Evaluate the E2E test results in /Users/amisskii/Downloads/win-1022h2-ent-nightly/results/podman-desktop
evals.expected_output: A single JSON object (no markdown, no prose) with summary, failures array (each failure has test/suite/spec_file/line/error/classification/confidence/title/root_cause/evidence/recommended_action/layer fields), skipped_analysis, and platform. The title field must be a non-empty 3-6 word noun phrase for every failure. The layer field reflects what grounded the root_cause: 1 for error-context.md, 2 for app stdout/stderr in json-results.json, 3 for trace evidence. Summary must match the run: 319 total, 252 passed, 4 failed, 63 skipped, duration_s 2264.5. Error strings must be free of ANSI escape sequences and spec_file paths must use forward slashes.

assertions.name: output is parseable JSON
assertions.description: The entire stdout can be parsed by json.loads() without error

assertions.name: every failure has title field
assertions.description: failures array is non-empty and every item has a non-empty 'title' string

assertions.name: every failure has layer field
assertions.description: every failure object has a 'layer' integer (1, 2, or 3)

assertions.name: summary fields present
assertions.description: summary object has total, passed, failed, skipped, flaky, duration_s

assertions.name: summary matches json-results stats
assertions.description: total=319, passed=252, failed=4, skipped=63, flaky=0, duration_s=2264.5 (stats.duration converted from ms)

assertions.name: no ANSI escape sequences in output
assertions.description: no failure error or root_cause contains an ESC[ sequence such as \u001b[2m or a bare '[22m' fragment

assertions.name: spec_file uses forward slashes
assertions.description: every spec_file is a forward-slash path with no backslashes, despite the Windows-produced report

assertions.name: suite excludes the spec file path
assertions.description: no suite value contains '.spec.ts' — it holds the describe title only

assertions.name: skipped_analysis present
assertions.description: skipped_analysis object is present with total_skipped, by_design, cascade fields

assertions.name: skip buckets are evidence-based and sum to the total
assertions.description: by_design=46, cascade=17, unresolved=0 — by_design is the count of skipped tests carrying a skip/fixme annotation, cascade the serial-annotated ones with a failed predecessor, and the three sum to total_skipped (63)

assertions.name: no markdown fences in output
assertions.description: output does not contain ```json or ``` wrappers

evals.prompt: Evaluate the E2E test results in /Users/amisskii/Downloads/win-1125h2-ent-latest/results/podman-desktop
evals.expected_output: A single JSON object with summary, failures (all with title and layer fields), skipped_analysis, and platform. Windows 11 run with stable podman v6.1.3; summary is 319 total, 250 passed, 4 failed, 65 skipped, duration_s 2123.26. All 4 failures should have titles; shared-root-cause failures should have identical titles. The Compose and onboarding failures are explained by GitHub API rate limiting visible in the result stdout, so they should be classified infra and carry layer 2 — reaching that verdict without unzipping a trace is the point of this case.

assertions.name: output is parseable JSON
assertions.description: The entire stdout can be parsed by json.loads() without error

assertions.name: every failure has title field
assertions.description: failures array is non-empty and every item has a non-empty 'title' string

assertions.name: shared root cause → identical titles
assertions.description: if multiple failures have the same root_cause pattern, they carry the same title value

assertions.name: evidence field is non-empty for each failure
assertions.description: every failure has evidence array with at least one non-empty string

assertions.name: rate-limit cause found from logs
assertions.description: at least one failure cites the GitHub API rate limit (or the podman provider error) from result stdout/stderr and reports layer 2

assertions.name: skip buckets are evidence-based and sum to the total
assertions.description: by_design=48, cascade=17, unresolved=0, summing to total_skipped=65

assertions.name: buffer-only log evidence is read
assertions.description: the 'Setup Podman push notification is present' failure cites the podman CLI stderr ('machine "podman-machine-default" already exists' or 'already running'), which the report stores only as base64 'buffer' chunks — a scan that reads just the 'text' field cannot see it

assertions.name: root_cause stays within the length limit
assertions.description: every root_cause is at most two sentences and 45 words, with no nested parentheticals

assertions.name: no markdown fences in output
assertions.description: output does not contain ```json or ``` wrappers
